dea-med-037.text: The consultations of the Athena on logs JSON They're expensive and slow. DUAS Do optimizations drastically reduce bytes scanned by query? (Select DUAS alternatives)
options: Convert data to Parquet with compression
Partition by date and filter by partition columns
Use SELECT * instead of specific columns
Increase the number of bucks
Enable MFA Delete
dea-med-037.explanation: A) Correct: columnar + compression = reading only of the necessary columns, with much less bytes. B) Correct: partition pruning limits reading to filter folders. C) Incorrect: SELECT * is the opposite — scans all columns. D) Incorrect: the quantity of buckets does not affect the scanning.: MFA Delete is protection against exclusion.

dea-med-038.text: Which ones DUAS statements on the components of the AWS Glue Are they correct? (Select DUAS alternatives)
options: Data Catalog is the central metastore shared by Athena, EMR and Redshift Spectrum
The Glue requires the provision and administration of a Spark cluster of its own
The Job Bookmarks allow incremental processing, tracking what has already been processed
The Crawlers perform the transformations of ETL
DataBrew replaces Data Catalog
dea-med-038.explanation: A) Correct: a single metadata catalogue serves all analytical tools — the heart of the lake. Glue is serverless — Spark infrastructure is managed by AWS. C) Correct: bookmarks avoid reprocessing old data for each execution. D) Incorrect: crawlers DESCOBREM and catalogue; the transformations are the JOBS. E) Incorrect: DataBrew is visual data preparation; the catalog remains the Data Catalog.

dea-med-039.text: A Daily Pipeline (Glue + Step Functions) needs OBSERVABILIDADE minimum production. DUAS Do configurations form this base? (Select DUAS alternatives)
options: Disable Logs to Save
Rule of EventBridge for states FAILED publishing alert no SNS
Check dashboard manually when someone remembers
Alarms of the CloudWatch on key metrics (job errors, anonymous duration, IteratorAge of streams)
Roll the pipeline twice to ensure
dea-med-039.explanation: A) Incorrect: no logs no diagnosis. B) Correct: failure turns notification in real time to the team. C) Incorrect: memory monitoring is the anti-standard. D) Correct: alarms about error/duration/lag detect degradation before the user. E) Incorrect: re-execution blinds duplicates cost and can duplicate data.

dea-med-040.text: Which ones DUAS practices follow the principle of MENOR PRIVILEGY in data pipelines? (Select DUAS alternatives)
options: A single admin roll shared by all pipelines
Each job/pipeline with its own IAM Role, restricted to the buckets/tables you really use
Long-term credentials embedded in scripts
Permission s3:* in Resource:* to simplify
Read access of analysts granted by table/column via Lake Formation
dea-med-040.explanation: A) Incorrect: shared admin is the opposite of the lowest privilege. B) Correct: roles per pipeline limit damage radius and facilitate audit. C) Incorrect: fixed credentials in code are advertised leak. D) Incorrect: total curinga is the definition of excess privilege. E) Correct: granularity table/column gives each team only what is needed.
